title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
description: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.

title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
description: Ukraine and Russia have not confirmed the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

title: Six shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
description: Another 28 people are injured in the southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
description: The two attackers were shot dead after a gun battle outside Hebron, four days before Israel's general election.

title: One Killed Near Paris After Gunman Fires at Random, Officials Say
description: The shooter was arrested after firing from a car in several locations southwest of the capital. Antiterrorism prosecutors said they were exploring a racial or religious motive.

title: Gunmen Open Fire at Church in Jordan, Killing at Least Six
description: The shooting took place during a funeral in the southern province of Karak, home to a longstanding Christian community, according to Jordan’s national police force. It was one of the kingdom’s deadliest attacks in years.

title: Top clubs chase Jiu-Jitsu President’s Cup title in Abu Dhabi
description: ABU DHABI: Top clubs and academies from across the UAE are set to compete for the Jiu-Jitsu President’s Cup at Fatima Bint Mubarak Ladies Sports Academy in Abu Dhabi on Saturday, Oct. 24. Organized by the UAE Jiu-Jitsu and Mixed Martial Arts Federation, the event will feature athletes in the adults and U21 categories. title: BBC investigation claims systematic RSF attacks on El-Fasher’s hospitals
description: The BBC's investigation has uncovered evidence of at least 43 systematic attacks on hospitals in El-Fasher by Sudan's Rapid Support Forces (RSF) from May 2024 to October 2025, resulting in the closure of key medical facilities and the deaths or injuries of numerous healthcare workers. title: South Korea proposes holding border talks with North
description: South Korea seeks to initiate military talks with North Korea to address border tensions and reestablish communication after a DMZ explosion heightened hostilities.

title: Taiwan shuts down as Typhoon Champi approaches
description: Taiwan has closed shops and schools as Typhoon Champi nears, resulting in evacuations and flight cancelations. The typhoon is expected to pass northeast Taiwan, moving toward China and Japan.

title: One dead, three missing from ship in ‘distress’ in Black Sea: Romania
description: Romania’s rescue operation recovered nine people and one deceased body from a distressed ship in the Black Sea, while three remain missing. This incident follows a series of similar events involving suspected Russian drone attacks in the region.
